family: Popular automated/bot and indicator strategies and their actual tested results
notes: Report: /home/user/claude-workspace/research/families/bot_popular_indicators.md. Method: 11 web searches completed before the session-wide WebSearch budget (200/200) was exhausted; remainder of the sweep done by ~35 direct page fetches (TradingView/LuxAlgo script pages, vendor pages, independent test write-ups, QuantConnect backtest caches, Trustpilot) plus GitHub code search to pull exact Pine formulas/defaults. quantifiedstrategies.com main site, SSRN and Medium were bot-blocked (403); substack/mirror equivalents used. Headline: no popular TradingView indicator strategy has credible independent after-cost evidence of an intraday edge on ES/NQ; independent intraday tests show 35-45% win rates and PF 0.86-1.10 outside strong trend regimes; synthetic-bar (Heikin-Ashi/Renko/range) backtests are documented as inflated by NinjaTrader support, EliteTrader and pine maintainers; LuxAlgo/Nadaraya-Watson repaint. The one strategy in scope with real evidence on ES/NQ 1-minute data with explicit futures costs is the intraday noise-area momentum breakout (Zarattini et al.; Quantitativo replication: NQ Sharpe 1.67, 24.3%/yr, DD 24%, 38% win, payoff 2.25, 65% positive months, edge concentrated 2018-2025). Vendor bots: Goldilocks (only verifiable live track) PF 1.32, 48% win, $45/trade on 2 MGC, max DD $8,368 (4.2x Lucid's $2,000 room); Vector Algorithmics shut down with Trustpilot reports of 50% losses and Apex closing accounts for bot use. Prop-fit rule used: any system whose 1-mini max DD exceeds ~$1,200-1,500 or whose typical big day exceeds ~$1,200 fails Lucid's $2,000 EOD-trailing DD or 50% consistency rule. Engine must: fill at real 1-min OHLC with >=1 tick slippage/side + $2.25-2.50/side mini commission, evaluate only confirmed bars, force flat by 15:55 ET, and walk-forward through 2022 and 2023 H2 chop, not just 2025-2026.

strategies.name: Supertrend (10,3) trend-flip, always in
strategies.origin: Olivier Seban; TradingView built-in; most-used webhook bot indicator (PickMyTrade/TradersPost)
strategies.entry: hl2=(H+L)/2; upper=hl2+mult*ATR(len); lower=hl2-mult*ATR(len); bands ratchet (lower only rises while close stays above, upper only falls); direction flips up when close > prior final upper band, down when close < prior final lower band. Long on flip up, short on flip down.
strategies.exit: Opposite flip (always in). Prop variants add fixed $ stop and 15:55 ET flat.
strategies.parameters: ATR 10 / mult 3 default (Wilder ATR); 14/3 (LST test); 7/2 for 1-5m MNQ scalping; 14/2.5 5-min and 10/3 15-min (prop vendor). Multiplier outside 2.5-3.5 degrades sharply.
strategies.instruments: Tested on Gold/NZDUSD tick data, Dow 30 stocks 5-min and daily, S&P weekly, NQ and Gold daily futures
strategies.timeframe_session: 5-min to weekly; no session filter in canonical form
strategies.claimed_performance: dev.to tick test 2020-2026 after spread+$3.50/lot/side: Gold H4 267 trades 43.4% win PF 1.97 (PF 3.19 in 2024-26 rally, 1.02 in 2022-23); NZDUSD H1 1,115 trades 35.6% win PF 0.86. LST Dow30 14/3: 5-min 2,597 trades 42% win avg +0.8%/-0.4% DD -7%; daily 1,455 trades 43% win DD -39%, 'not profitable'. Quantified Strategies S&P weekly 10/3 1960-2026: 41 trades 68% win DD 25%. Algomatic daily NQ 2005-2026: 93 trades 52.69% win CAGR 4.59% DD -14.22%; Gold 91 trades 47.25% win CAGR 5.72% DD -15.10%.
strategies.prop_fit: Poor stand-alone intraday: 35-45% win with multi-day losing strings in chop will consume $2,000 EOD-trailing DD on 1 mini. Use only as trailing exit or HTF direction filter.

strategies.name: Supertrend prop-firm session variant (RTH filter, fixed $ stop, daily kill switch)
strategies.origin: propfirmpinescripts.com and similar prop-bot vendors (2024-2026)
strategies.entry: Supertrend 14/2.5 on 5-min MES/MNQ (or 10/3 on 15-min) flip, taken only 09:30-16:00 ET (preferred 09:30-11:30 ET), direction must agree with VWAP side and opening bias; bar-close execution.
strategies.exit: Opposite flip or fixed dollar stop ($50-100 MES, $30-60 MNQ 5-min; $75-150 / $50-100 15-min); flat before close.
strategies.parameters: ATR 14 mult 2.5 (5m); ATR 10 mult 3.0 (15m); kill switch at 80% of firm daily limit; no entries within 30 min of NFP/CPI/FOMC.
strategies.filters: RTH session, VWAP agreement, news blackout, daily loss buffer.
strategies.claimed_performance: Vendor claim, NQ 15-min 2024-2026: 48-55% win, avg winner 2.0-2.5x avg loser, 1-3 trades/session, strings of 3-5 losers. No trade log, no cost statement.
strategies.prop_fit: Scaffolding (session filter, $ stop, kill switch, news blackout) is correct for Lucid and should be reused around any strategy; the signal itself is unproven. Run as a baseline only.
strategies.data_requirements: OHLC; VWAP needs volume (approximate with hl2 time-weighted average).

strategies.name: UT Bot Alerts (ATR trailing stop, QuantNomad/Yo_adriiiiaan)
strategies.origin: TradingView open-source script; basis of 'ULTIMATE scalping' YouTube strategies
strategies.entry: nLoss=a*ATR(c). stop: if src>stop[1] and src[1]>stop[1] then max(stop[1], src-nLoss); elif src<stop[1] and src[1]<stop[1] then min(stop[1], src+nLoss); else src>stop[1] ? src-nLoss : src+nLoss. Buy when src>stop and crossover(EMA(src,1), stop); Sell when src<stop and crossover(stop, EMA(src,1)). Strategy: long on Buy, short on Sell.
strategies.exit: Opposite signal (always in); combos add TP ladders / swing stops.
strategies.parameters: Defaults a=1 (Key Value), c=10 (ATR period), Heikin Ashi source off. Popular: a=2,c=1 on 5-min; a=1.5-2,c=5-10 for 1-5m; a=3-4,c=10-14 for 1H-4H; a=2,c=6 in Ultimate-scalping combo.
strategies.instruments: Community backtests mostly crypto/stocks; no ES/NQ test with costs found
strategies.claimed_performance: TradeSearcher aggregate of 105 community backtests: avg PF 1.0, avg max DD 65%. Anecdotes: EUR/USD 4H ~60% win over ~25 trades; BTC 15m 8 of 12 signals hit 1:2R in two weeks; Freqtrade crypto port '3202%' with no costs. No independent index-futures intraday evidence.
strategies.prop_fit: Poor stand-alone: a=2/c=1 on 5-min NQ flips several times per hour in chop; negative expectancy after $5/tick costs in every honest comparable test. Trailing-stop formula is a usable exit.
strategies.data_requirements: OHLC; Heikin-Ashi option must be off for honest fills.

strategies.name: Chandelier Exit trend-flip (everget) with optional 200 EMA filter
strategies.origin: Charles Le Beau; TradingView port by everget (GPL-3)
strategies.entry: longStop=highest(close,len)-mult*ATR(len) ratcheted up (longStop:=close[1]>longStop[1]?max(longStop,longStop[1]):longStop); shortStop=lowest(close,len)+mult*ATR(len) ratcheted down; dir=close>shortStop[1]?1:close<longStop[1]?-1:dir[1]. Buy on dir flip to 1 (optionally only if close>EMA200), sell on flip to -1 (close<EMA200).
strategies.exit: Opposite flip.
strategies.parameters: length 22, mult 3.0, useClose=true (everget defaults); StockCharts variants 22x1 and 22x2 (tighter 22x1 performed better).
strategies.filters: EMA(200) direction filter in common bot variants.
strategies.instruments: No independent intraday futures test; daily ETF use as exit only
strategies.claimed_performance: No published metrics for the flip system. As an exit in StockCharts RSI(5) system (SPY/QQQ/IJR daily 2000-2016) the tighter 22x1 improved CAR and drawdown everywhere.
strategies.prop_fit: Same object as Supertrend/UT Bot (ratcheting ATR stop); fine as exit, unproven as entry.

strategies.name: RSI(5) dip-buy with Chandelier Exit (StockCharts SystemTrader)
strategies.origin: Arthur Hill, StockCharts SystemTrader, Dec 2016
strategies.entry: Regime: S&P 500 50-day SMA > 200-day SMA. Buy next open when RSI(5) crosses below 30 (variant A) or crosses back above 30 (variant B). Long only.
strategies.exit: Close below Chandelier Exit (22,1) or (22,2); sell next open. $10 commission.
strategies.parameters: RSI 5, threshold 30; CE 22 period, 1 or 2 ATR; $100k capital.
strategies.filters: 50/200 SMA golden-cross regime filter on S&P 500.
strategies.claimed_performance: 2000-12 to 2016-12: SPY (22,1) variant B CAR 4.8% 62% win DD -20.8%; QQQ (22,1) B CAR 6.1% 60% win DD -25.6%; IJR (22,1) B CAR 10.8% 83% win DD -12.6%, 80 trades, 35% exposure. Tighter exit better everywhere.
strategies.prop_fit: Not usable as published (overnight holds). Intraday translation (RSI(5) on 5-min < 30 in up-trending session, exit on 22-bar 1-ATR chandelier or 15:55 ET) is a standard interpretation, untested.

strategies.name: Hull MA slope flip / Hull Suite (InSilico)
strategies.origin: Alan Hull (2005); TradingView Hull Suite by InSilico
strategies.entry: HMA(n)=WMA(2*WMA(src,n/2)-WMA(src,n), round(sqrt(n))); EHMA same with EMA; THMA(n)=WMA(3*WMA(src,n/3)-WMA(src,n/2)-WMA(src,n), n). Up when HULL>HULL[2], down when HULL<HULL[2]; long on up flip, short on down flip. Alt: price crosses HMA(40) on 30-min bars (QuantConnect).
strategies.exit: Opposite flip (always in); Oxford Strat adds 6xATR(20) stop.
strategies.parameters: Hull Suite default length 55 (180-200 for floating S/R); Oxford Strat slow length 250 base, 750 best, fast index 1.0 (second HMA redundant); QC HMA 40 on 30-min.
strategies.claimed_performance: Oxford Strat (no costs): length 250 CAGR 11.5% Sharpe 0.60 DD 58% win 30.8% PF 1.10; length 750 CAGR 18.9% Sharpe 0.93 DD 49.9%; only lengths >500 viable, rated C. QuantConnect SPY 30-min HMA40 cross: CAGR 5.45% Sharpe 0.43 DD 9.3% win rate 5% with P/L ratio 22.4, 200 trades, $240 fees.
strategies.prop_fit: Poor: 5% win / 95% small losses trips a $2,000 EOD-trailing DD before the rare big winner, which then trips the 50% consistency rule.

strategies.name: Hull Suite + LSMA 'best 1-minute scalping' (YouTube; Myth-Busting #9)
strategies.origin: YouTube 'I Tested The Best 1 Minute Scalping Strategy'; automated by myncrypto Strategy Myth-Busting #9
strategies.entry: 1-min chart. Long when Hull Suite(55) is red and LSMA(25) crosses above the Hull line; short when Hull Suite is green and LSMA crosses below.
strategies.exit: Stop at latest swing low/high; target 1:4 R; optional ADX>25 filter off by default.
strategies.parameters: LSMA 25; Hull 55; commission 0.075%; $1,000 capital.
strategies.claimed_performance: No results published by the automator; YouTube claim unverified.
strategies.prop_fit: Counter-trend 1:4R needs ~25% win just to break even; on 1-min NQ with $5/tick costs a long shot. Not recommended.

strategies.name: Squeeze Momentum (LazyBear / TTM Squeeze) breakout
strategies.origin: John Carter 'Mastering the Trade'; LazyBear SQZMOM_LB open-source script
strategies.entry: BB(20,2.0), KC(20,1.5,true range). sqzOn=lowerBB>lowerKC and upperBB<upperKC; sqzOff=lowerBB<lowerKC and upperBB>upperKC. val=linreg(close-avg(avg(highest(high,20),lowest(low,20)),sma(close,20)),20,0). Long on first sqzOff bar after a squeeze when val>0 and rising; short when val<0 and falling.
strategies.exit: val fades toward zero / histogram colour change, or fixed stop at opposite KC band and 2R target; 15:55 ET flat in prop variant.
strategies.parameters: BB length 20 mult 2.0; KC length 20 mult 1.5; momentum linreg 20; source ohlc4 in Bitduke port.
strategies.instruments: XBTUSD/ETHUSD 1H-4H (Bitduke); AAPL 3-min/2H anecdote; no ES/NQ test
strategies.claimed_performance: Bitduke: ~12% max DD on BTC/ETH 1H-4H, no profit/win figures. AAPL 3-min 14 trades 50% then 38%; 2H 4/4 then 70%. LuxAlgo: 'squeezes can fire into failed moves'.
strategies.prop_fit: Low signal frequency helps consistency, but no evidence of edge after costs. Research variant: 5-min ES/NQ release 09:45-14:30 ET, stop opposite KC band, 2R or 15:55 ET.
strategies.data_requirements: OHLC (Carter's original wants volume; LazyBear's does not).

strategies.name: Nadaraya-Watson Envelope mean reversion (LuxAlgo, endpoint mode)
strategies.origin: LuxAlgo open-source; viral on YouTube 2022-2024
strategies.entry: Endpoint (non-repainting) mode: w(i)=exp(-(i^2)/(2h^2)), basis=sum(src[i]*w(i))/sum(w(i)) over window; dev=SMA(|src-basis|,window)*mult; upper=basis+dev, lower=basis-dev. Long when close crosses back above lower band; short when it crosses back below upper band.
strategies.exit: At basis, or %-stop / %-target (strategy port uses slPercent/tpPercent).
strategies.parameters: h (bandwidth) 8.0; mult 3.0; window 500 bars; repainting smoothing must be OFF.
strategies.instruments: No independent test on any instrument found
strategies.claimed_performance: LuxAlgo: 'extremity crossings describe stretch, not guaranteed reversals, and nothing suggests this envelope outperforms traditional band tools.' All viral hit-rate claims come from the repainting default mode.
strategies.prop_fit: Mean-reversion at 3x MAD on 1-5 min ES/NQ fires mostly on trend days. Not recommended; if tested use endpoint mode, regime filter, hard stop.
strategies.data_requirements: OHLC; must use non-repainting endpoint mode.

strategies.name: MACD (12,26,9) zero-line / signal-cross trend
strategies.origin: Gerald Appel; universal default; LiberatedStockTrader test
strategies.entry: Long when MACD histogram > 0 and MACD > 0 and MACD > signal; executed next open or HL2.
strategies.exit: When signal > MACD.

strategies.name: RSI(14) 30/70 cross mean reversion
strategies.origin: Wilder; LiberatedStockTrader multi-timeframe test
strategies.entry: Buy when RSI(14) crosses above 30.
strategies.exit: Sell when RSI(14) crosses below 70.

strategies.name: MACD + RSI + 200 EMA combo (standard interpretation)
strategies.origin: Ubiquitous YouTube/TradingView scalp; no canonical source
strategies.entry: 5-min, 09:35-15:30 ET. Long: close > EMA(200), RSI(14) < 30 within last 5 bars and now rising, MACD(12,26,9) line crosses above signal. Short mirrored (RSI > 70, close < EMA200).

strategies.name: Heikin-Ashi colour-flip trend + 50 EMA
strategies.origin: Generic; PickMyTrade automation guide; NinjaTrader/EliteTrader backtest-integrity threads
strategies.entry: haClose=(O+H+L+C)/4; haOpen=(haOpen[1]+haClose[1])/2. Long when HA turns green (haClose>haOpen) and real close > EMA(50); short mirrored.
strategies.exit: First opposite-colour HA candle or fixed target (vendor example 20 ES points); must execute at real OHLC.
strategies.parameters: EMA 50 (or 1H HA trend confirmation for 5-min entries); RSI>50 variant.
strategies.filters: EMA(50) side; optional higher-timeframe HA agreement.
strategies.claimed_performance: Vendor: 65% backtested win on ES 5-min in 2024 bull runs, 55% live after fees; TradingView results overstated 10-15%. NinjaTrader forum: 46,000-trade ES HA backtest showed a '10% edge' that was 'too massive to be real' because fills were at synthetic HA prices; pine maintainers: synthetic-bar fills are 'reliably flattering, never reproducible'. LST MACD test: HA raised apparent win 40%->44%.
strategies.prop_fit: Only acceptable with fills at real OHLC and >=1 tick slippage; the HA flip is then a lagging 2-bar average cross with no evidence of edge.
strategies.data_requirements: OHLC; FLAG must fill on real bars, never HA prices.

strategies.name: Smoothed Heikin-Ashi Trend (TraderHalai BACKTEST)
strategies.origin: TraderHalai TradingView open-source strategy
strategies.entry: HA computed on SMA(10)-smoothed OHLC; script computes the real close needed to flip HA colour; long on green flip, short on red flip.
strategies.exit: 1% stop (long/short); opposite flip. Market orders; 0.1% commission; 10 ticks slippage; repainting off; 10% equity sizing.
strategies.parameters: Smoothing SMA 10.
strategies.claimed_performance: BTC 8H: 1,046 trades +249%, CAGR 14.0%, DD 7.9%, win 28%, PF 2.02; 1D: 429 trades +458%, PF 2.80; 5D: 69 trades +1,615%, PF 10.45 (self-reported, long-bias era).

strategies.name: Ichimoku Cloud breakout (9,26,52)
strategies.origin: Goichi Hosoda; LiberatedStockTrader, QuantConnect, Wooster independent study tests
strategies.entry: Long when close > Senkou A and close > Senkou B (above cloud); QuantConnect variant: long when Chikou crosses above cloud, short when below.
strategies.exit: Close < both spans (below cloud); or opposite Chikou cross.
strategies.instruments: Dow 30 daily 20 yrs; SPY weekly 2019-2020; top-10 US energy stocks 2015-2020
strategies.claimed_performance: Dow 30: 90% of stocks underperform B&H, ~60% of trades lose; QQQ +175% vs +815% B&H (66 trades, R/R 2.85); SPY +118% vs +294% (59 trades, R/R 3.01). QuantConnect energy: Sharpe -0.31 vs XLE -0.08 (2015-2020). Wooster: SPY weekly underperforms B&H.
strategies.prop_fit: Exclude: slow, low win rate, consistently negative vs benchmark, no intraday evidence.

strategies.name: Renko / range-bar brick-reversal scalp
strategies.origin: Generic NinjaTrader/TradingView scalping lore; no canonical tested source
strategies.entry: Renko brick = k*ATR(14) (NQ 10-20 pts, ES 2-4 pts) or fixed range bars (NQ 8-12 pts); long after 2 consecutive up bricks following a down brick (or colour flip with EMA(20) of brick closes rising); short mirrored.

strategies.parameters: Brick/range size; EMA 20 of bricks.

strategies.prop_fit: Exclude as entry engine.
strategies.data_requirements: FLAG: exact bricks need tick data; only approximable from 1-minute OHLC; fills must be at real prices.

strategies.name: Intraday noise-area momentum breakout (Zarattini-Aziz-Barbon; Quantitativo ES/NQ replication)
strategies.origin: SSRN 4824172 'Beat the Market: An Effective Intraday Momentum Strategy for S&P500 ETF (SPY)' (2024); Quantitativo replication on ES/NQ with Databento 1-min data (Jan 2025)
strategies.entry: For each time-of-day t compute sigma_t = mean over last L days of |close_t/open_day - 1|. UB_t = max(open_day, prev_close)*(1+sigma_t); LB_t = min(open_day, prev_close)*(1-sigma_t). Long when price crosses above UB_t, short when it crosses below LB_t; one position, reversals allowed; paper checks every 30 min, 1-min bars work.
strategies.exit: Trailing stop = the crossed band (paper variant: VWAP); stopped if price re-enters the noise area; flat 15:50-15:55 ET.
strategies.parameters: L = 14 days (paper) or 90 days (Quantitativo optimized); size = target daily vol / realized 14-day vol, cap 4x (2% target) or 8x (3% target).
